reason: The test is run against base (before the fix). On base, REGEX_FORMAT matches Y{1,4}, so lone 'Y' and 'YYY' tokens are consumed by the regex and fall through to the timezone-offset fallback, producing UTC offset strings instead of literal characters.

The test is run against head (after the fix). The PR changes REGEX_FORMAT to match only YY and YYYY, so lone 'Y' and 'YYY' are no longer consumed by the format regex and are preserved as literal characters.

The test checks that percent-encoded route parameters are decoded. On base, the decode functionality already exists inline in request.ts (using tryDecode with a contains-%' check). The PR only refactors this into a shared utility without changing behavior.
The test checks percent-decoding of route parameters. On head, the refactored tryDecodeURIComponent utility is called from the same code paths, preserving the identical decode behavior.

The test is run against base. On base, SortedEntry#reschedule updates Redis via zincrby but never updates the in-memory @score field, so reading entry.score or entry.at after reschedule returns stale (pre-reschedule) values.
The test is run against head. The PR adds '@score = at.to_f' after the zincrby call, so the in-memory score is immediately updated to reflect the rescheduled time.
The test checks Content-Type header parsing with charset. The PR only modifies Range header parsing in Ranges.kt, which is entirely unrelated to Content-Type parsing. The test behavior is unchanged.
Same as jvm_0007: the PR only touches Range header parsing. Content-Type parsing with charset parameters is unaffected.
The test checks that archiving preserves file modification timestamps. The PR only changes error logging messages in ComposerRepository, which is unrelated to zip archive timestamp handling.
Same as kbc_0007: the PR only modifies log/exception messages. Archive timestamp behavior is unaffected.

The test checks asynchronous JSON deserialization of a type with a nullable parent property. The PR modifies CredentialCacheKey path comparison (network credential matching), which is entirely unrelated to JSON deserialization.
Same as kbc_0009: the PR only changes credential cache prefix comparison logic. JSON deserialization behavior is unaffected.
The test checks INET subnet containment using <<= ANY. The PR modifies FETCH FIRST cursor handling in sql_cursor.go, which is unrelated to INET type operations or the <<= ANY operator.
Same as kbd_0013: the PR only fixes cursor FETCH FIRST behavior. INET >>= ANY operation is unaffected.

The test is run against base. On base, NO_PROXY '::1' is always prefixed with a wildcard ('all://*::1'), which is not a valid URL pattern for IPv6 addresses, causing a URL parsing error during client construction.
The test is run against head. The PR adds is_ipv6_hostname detection and formats IPv6 NO_PROXY entries as 'all://[::1]' instead of the broken wildcard pattern, so client construction succeeds.

The test is run against base. On base, the flag validation in Series.str.match performs a strict equality check on the full flag set against the compiled pattern's flags, which fails for flags like DOTALL that are not.IGNORECASE.

The test is run against head. The PR restructures flag handling to only bake IGNORECASE into flags and only compare IGNORECASE against compiled patterns, allowing DOTALL and other flags to pass through correctly.

The test is run against base. On base, when a chain contains a group followed by more tasks, prepare_steps does not update prev_task/prev_res after processing the group, causing the second group's results to be incorrectly parented under the first group's final task.
The test is run against head. The PR adds code to update prev_task and prev_res after processing each group, so subsequent groups and tasks are correctly parented.

The test is run against base. On base, when -- appears and matches the current positional's value_terminator, the code still enters TrailingVals mode instead of letting the positional's terminator handle it, causing subsequent arguments to be incorrectly captured.

The test is run against head. The PR adds a check: if the current positional has a value_terminator that matches '--', the code skips entering TrailingVals mode and lets the positional parsing handle it correctly.

The test expects both OptionSet and ColorScheme autocommands to fire. On base, nvim_set_option_value triggers OptionSet when background is set. The startup guard only suppresses during starting; if OSC11 arrives after VimEnter, OptionSet fires. The test may be flaky due to timing but the expected behavior (both fire) can occur on base.

The test expects both OptionSet and ColorScheme to fire, but the PR uses :noautocmd to suppress OptionSet entirely, so only ColorScheme fires. The test's expected result (both fire) is not met on head.

The test checks required field validation (changeset with missing required field). The PR only reorders compile-time checks in schema.ex regarding @derive attribute reading for redacted fields, which does not affect runtime changeset validation behavior.
Same as sa_0007: the PR only changes the order of compile-time attribute reads in schema.ex. Runtime required-field validation on changesets is unaffected.
